violations.why: writer1_isr (priority 4) can preempt closer1_isr between its write and its read of expect_close, so the read no longer sees 42.
writer1_isr can preempt between closer1's check of expect_close and its later write, so the check goes stale.
This is a bug in the code as written. It uses 1036 as the first write, not 1035.
writer1_isr can preempt closer1 between its write of count=1 and its read, so the read sees 0.
writer2_isr can preempt closer2 between its write of count=1 and its read, so the read sees 0.
writer1_isr can preempt closer1's JudgeCondi between its two reads of test_global_var1, so the reads can see different values.
writer2_isr can preempt closer2 between its two reads of test_global_var3, so the reads can see different values.
